companies.icp: US-headquartered, owner-led industrial manufacturers with roughly 50 to 200 employees
qualifies: Manufactures, fabricates, machines, assembles or processes physical industrial products
Describes itself as family-owned, founder-led or privately held
disqualifies: Distributors, dealers, retailers or service businesses that do not manufacture
Primarily aerospace, defense, firearms or software
Subsidiary of a public company, foreign group or private equity platform
companies.lean: lean YES when the identity language fits

discovery.objective: Find companies that hired a new head of finance (CFO, VP Finance or Controller) from outside the company on or after 2025-01-01. Any company, any size, any industry, anywhere: fit is decided later.

match_conditions.name: new_outside_finance_leader
match_conditions.description: A dated source shows a CFO, VP Finance or Controller joined the company from a different organization on or after 2025-01-01.

signals.research_brief: Establish who currently controls this company, who the new finance leader is and when they first joined the company in any role, and one concrete current piece of company work that could be referenced honestly.

fields.name: owner_full_name
fields.description: Full name of the current owner or family principal who is still active in the business.

fields.name: owner_title
fields.description: That person's current title at the company.

fields.name: new_leader_full_name
fields.description: Full name of the current finance leader who joined from outside.

fields.name: new_leader_company_join_date
fields.description: Earliest verified date this person joined the company in ANY role (not the start of their current title).

fields.name: new_leader_is_outside_hire
fields.description: True only if a source shows the person came from a different organization; false for promotions or retitles.

fields.name: work_clue
fields.description: One specific, current or recent company work detail (expansion, new line, acquisition, program launch) stated in a source.

rules.description: Company is still owner or family controlled
New leader was hired from outside
New leader first joined the company on or after 2025-01-01
